351705.title: A voided invoice is left out of every dashboard figure
351705.pre:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

User: you are signed in as a user whose role has the Reports permission (for example Admin).
Browser: you use a desktop browser window at least 1024 pixels wide (a maximised laptop or desktop window).
Location: a location for the void check exists (for example ZZAUTOTEST Void Shop) with two invoices, not paid and not sent: customer ZZAUTOTEST Keep Fleet, one labor line of 1.00 hour at $100.00 an hour with Tech Time 1.00 and exactly 1.00 hour clocked on it; customer ZZAUTOTEST Void Fleet, one labor line of 2.00 hours at $150.00 an hour (e.g. $300.00) with Tech Time 2.00 and nobody clocked on it.
User: you can switch to a location with at-risk customers, and you have written down one at-risk customer's name and Last Invoice Date (Dashboard > View details on At Risk Customers).
351705.steps:
With ZZAUTOTEST Void Shop selected, click Dashboard in the top menu (all tiles on their defaults) and write down every headline and supporting line.
Void the Void Fleet invoice: on that work order's Lines tab add a New Line (any small line) while the invoice is still unpaid and unsent. The Finance tab now shows the invoice as voided. Do not create a new invoice.
Reload the dashboard and read every headline and supporting line again.
Change location to the location with the at-risk customer (profile icon > Change Location), click Dashboard in the top menu and write down the At Risk headline.
Create a new work order for that customer: Work Orders > Create Work Order > the customer and an asset > Save; in New Line one labor line (e.g. Labor Rate EVR Travel to EVO, Estimated Time 0.5), tick Line Approved > Save & Close; Story > Update; Complete; Mark Reviewed; Finance > Create Invoice (do not pay or send).
Reload the dashboard and read the At Risk headline.
Void that invoice the same way (add a New Line on its Lines tab).
Reload the dashboard, click View details on At Risk Customers and find the customer.
351705.exp:
Expected results

Step 1: Before the void (step 1): Revenue $400.00 (100.00 + 300.00), "2 customers", Billing Efficiency 300.00% (3.00 invoiced hours ÷ 1.00 clocked hour) and Technician Efficiency 300.00% (3.00 ÷ 1.00).
Step 3: After the void, the voided invoice contributes nothing. Revenue $100.00 and its Parts/Labor split "Parts 0% · Labor 100%". Billing Efficiency 100.00% with "1.00 Invoiced / 1.00 Clocked". Technician Efficiency 100.00% with "1.00 Invoiced Tech Hrs / 1.00 Clocked". Sales by Customer "1 customer" (Void Fleet no longer counted).
Step 3: The matching reports (Sales, Service Advisor Analysis, Technician Efficiency, Sales By Customer) leave the voided invoice out in the same way.
Step 6: While the at-risk customer's new invoice was live, they dropped out of At Risk (the headline went down by 1).
Step 8: After that invoice is voided, the customer is back in the At Risk table with their old Last Invoice Date (e.g. Oct 10, 2025): the voided invoice is not treated as their most recent invoice.Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-490; story SV-9575 (Story 3, Measure Formulas and Report Parity); Dashboard v1 PRD, Confluence 788430850 v42, read 7 Oct 2026, Story 3. How to produce a voided invoice by hand comes from the Technical Implementation Plan (2026-09-16) section 7: an invoice is voided by adding a line while it is still pending; reversing an invoice deletes it rather than voiding it.
Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

S3-E2: “A voided invoice is excluded from every figure the dashboard shows. It contributes nothing to Revenue or to the parts-versus-labor split, nothing to invoiced hours or invoiced technician hours, and it is counted in neither the Sales by Customer count nor the At Risk Customers count, including when deciding a customer's most recent invoice. This is not a dashboard rule of its own: it is what the reports do, and the dashboard matches them (S3-R1). A void means the document was undone, so a figure that still carried its money or its hours would overstate the shop.”Last checked against build v26.40.8-754bd3a on 10/13/2026.

The twelfth point is computed as of now, rather than as of a month end that has not happened yet, so it always equals the headline.
